title: Primer of the First Hum
summary: A primer for the rare early-awakened Monarch whose soul has just begun to ring and who learns to lend that ring to a companion.

title: The Tuning Handbook
summary: A handbook that teaches a new soul cultivator to find the pitch of a friendly soul and to hold a clean note beside it.

title: A Drill-Book of Matched Notes
summary: A drill-book of small exercises in setting one soul note beside another until the two sound as one clean line.

title: Handbook of the Steady Beat
summary: A short handbook on keeping an even beat in the soul and sharing that beat so that an ally never hurries or drags.

title: Guide to the Lending Voice
summary: A guide to lending the strength of one soul voice to another so that a weak technique carries with a fuller sound.

title: The Common Chord Primer
summary: A primer on the chord that three souls of one rung can share and the first guards and mendings that grow from it.
